input: 한국어 손글씨 메모 사진을 텍스트로 옮기는 모델이 필요해. 앱 서버에서 돌릴 거라 3B 이하였으면 해.
outputs: The model is designed for handwriting recognition, specifically targeting Korean handwritten notes. It supports Korean as its primary language and is optimized for performance with a parameter count of 2.5 billion, making it suitable for deployment on app servers. The model excels in accurately converting images of handwritten text into digital text, ensuring high fidelity in transcription. Its intended use cases include mobile applications for note-taking, educational tools for digitizing student notes, and archival systems for preserving handwritten documents. With a focus on speed and accuracy, this model is a robust solution for developers looking to integrate handwriting recognition capabilities into their applications.
